questions.subject: databases
questions.html:
Consider a database table T containing
two columns X and Y each of type Integer.
After the creation of the table, one record
(X=1, Y=1) is inserted in the table. Let MX
and MY denote the respective maximum
values of X and Y among all records in the
table at any point in time. Using MX and
MY, new records are inserted in the table
128 times with X and Y values being
MX+1, 2 × MY+1 respectively. It may be
noted that each time after the insertion,
values of MX and MY change. What will
be the output of the following SQL query
after the steps mentioned above are
carried out?
SELECT Y FROM T WHERE X=7;

(a) 127

(b) 15

(c) 129

(d) 257
